messages:
Riley: FYI — working on an MDX migration PR that tweaks the SDK snippet import paths and adds a migration guide. Need reviews before the feature-flag cutoff tomorrow 11:00 PT. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4219
Sam: Can you paste the failing preview link? I can run a quick pass on the code examples.
Riley: Preview is at https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4219 but the build fails on frontmatter parsing for `guides/migration.mdx`. Error from mkdocs: `Invalid YAML: mapping values are not allowed here`. I pushed a tentative fix in `docs/mdx-migrate-4219` to escape a colon in the metadata.
DocBot: docs-preview build failed: ERROR in parsing `guides/migration.mdx`: line 7: could not parse key
```
  File "/workspace/guides/migration.mdx", line 7
    version: v2.0:beta
                   ^
  YAMLError: mapping values are not allowed here
```
Priya: That's the old inline version tag we used. Change to `version: "v2.0-beta"` and it should parse. Also watch that MDX frontmatter doesn't include raw JSX comments.
Sam: I'll do a quick examples pass. Noticed one snippet imports `from redwood import Client` but SDK renamed to `redwood_inference` last month. Riley, can you update snippets to `from redwood_inference import Client`?
Riley: Good catch — I missed that rename. Will update and push.
DocBot: docs-preview build queued... job 9129.
DocBot: docs-preview build completed  success. Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr-4219/ 
QA-bot: visual-regression check queued (job 5993).
Kai: Release ops note: cutoff for this release is tomorrow 11:00 PT. Per process we need merges by 09:30 PT to allow docs propagation and release branch cherry-pick if needed. Is this going to versioned docs?
Riley: Yes — migration guide will live under `/docs/v2.0/guides/migration` and we add a redirect from `/guides/migration`. I updated `mkdocs.yml` to include the `v2.0` nav.
Priya: If you're touching versioned nav, add a changelog entry in `v2.0/CHANGELOG.md` and bump the `versioned_docs` config. Also note that the feature flag controlling the new SDK import is `ff:mdx-sdk-import` — release will gate that flag.
Sam: Code review done. Fixed a tiny formatting nit and updated the Python snippet to include `with Client(api_key=...) as client:` pattern. LGTM.
Kai: Approving from release side. Reminder: merge message should include `cherry-pick: release/v2.0` if we need to backport to the release branch. Otherwise merge to `main` and flag release lead.
Riley: CI green, visual checks passed. Merging now and adding `cherry-pick: release/v2.0` per Kai so release can decide.
DocBot: merged PR #4219 into `main` by Riley at 08:42 PT. Commit `b4c2d1e`.
QA-bot: scheduled staging deploy for commit `b4c2d1e`... smoke tests running.
QA-bot: smoke tests passed  all examples executed successfully.
Kai: Will monitor cherry-pick request. If release team wants it in the cut, they'll cherry-pick and set `ff:mdx-sdk-import=true` in the release manifest.
Priya: Thanks all. If the release decides to skip the cherry-pick, I'll open a follow-up patch to add a short note in `v1.x` about the import name change so users on older docs aren't surprised.
Riley: Closing thread — appreciate the quick reviews. Ping me if anything looks off on production docs after CDN propagation. :rocket:
